free_tier.stated: No free tier. Cheapest paid offer: MVPS 1 on the 10 Gbit metered NVMe KVM line, 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, 10 Gbit shared port, 3 TB bandwidth, 1 IPv4 and 1 IPv6, USD 3.99 per month, with 10% off on a 1-year plan. Locations: USA, Canada, France, Germany, Netherlands, UK, Turkey, Hong Kong and India, plus an OFFSHORE entry.
free_tier.notes: MVPS 2 is 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, 5 TB at USD 6.99 per month; MVPS 3 is 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 40 GB NVMe, 8 TB at USD 9.99 per month; the 1 Gbps Budget NVMe NANO is 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 30 GB NVMe, 3 TB at USD 6.49 per month

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not stored bytes; no deletion or suspension term was read
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process and its disk

egress.terms: 3 TB a month of bandwidth on MVPS 1 over a 10 Gbit port connected to the node as a common channel; the Turkey location has reduced bandwidth quotas; no overage price was read

interface_detail: a WHMCS client area at hostaddon.com/clients; no API or CLI was read
tooling: client-area panel and support tickets; no API, CLI or Terraform provider was read on the pages fetched
chaining: A 10 Gbit shared port with 3 TB a month at USD 3.99 across 9 locations, including Hong Kong, India and Turkey, gives a low-priced exit point in regions that few budget hosts cover.
